The Thursday Ride – Trek Fort Worth South

Fort Worth, TX · Wedgwood · Road

The Thursday Ride – Trek Fort Worth South is a road group ride in Fort Worth, TX. It rolls every Thursday at 6:15 pm from Trek Bicycle Fort Worth South. About 18 miles, 14–16 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Thursday Ride – Trek Fort Worth South group ride

A weeknight shop ride from the Trek store on Granbury Road. About 18 miles at 14 to 16 mph. It is a drop ride, so you need to hold that pace. Helmets and daytime lights required. Cancellations are posted on the shop's Facebook by noon Wednesday.
